pictures.name: single_full_bowl_set_apart
pictures.scene: one plain clay bowl heaped full and set by itself apart from everything else on a stone table, the bowl lit warm and gold at the bottom of the frame, the room above and behind it dim and quiet

pictures.name: sun_low_along_an_open_path
pictures.scene: a low sun sitting straight down the length of an open path and filling it with light, the near track lit warm and gold at the bottom of the frame, the bright horizon and sky above it pale and wide

pictures.name: footprints_turning_back_toward_the_track
pictures.scene: a line of footprints in soft earth that wanders aside and then turns and comes back to the main track, the nearest prints lit warm and clear low in the frame, the ground beyond them flat and dim

pictures.name: sandals_left_ready_by_the_door
pictures.scene: a worn pair of leather sandals set neatly side by side ready at an open doorway, the sandals lit warm and low at the bottom of the frame, the doorway and the light beyond it pale and quiet

pictures.name: tangled_rope_across_a_doorway
pictures.scene: a coarse rope snarled and strung untidily across an open doorway, the rope lit hard and warm at the bottom of the frame, the lit room beyond and above it plain and pale and standing quite open

pictures.name: lamp_lit_at_the_deepest_hour
pictures.scene: one lamp newly lit on a low table in the very middle of the night, its flame and the table lit warm and gold at the bottom of the frame, the whole room above it deep and black and perfectly still

pictures.name: two_cups_set_together_on_a_table
pictures.scene: two plain clay cups set close together and both filled on a low wooden table, the cups lit warm and gold at the bottom of the frame, the room above and behind them brown and dim and quiet

pictures.name: whole_country_green_after_rain
pictures.scene: a wide country turned green from end to end after long rain with water standing in the hollows, the near grass lit warm and bright at the bottom of the frame, the hills and sky above it soft and pale

pictures.name: open_hillside_track_at_first_light
pictures.scene: a clear track over an open hillside taking the very first light of the morning, the near ground lit warm and gold at the bottom of the frame, the slope and the sky above it pale and calm and waiting

lines.text: I have promised to keep Your words.
I have sought Your face with all my heart;
be gracious to me according to Your promise.
and turned my steps to Your testimonies.
Though the ropes of the wicked bind me,
I do not forget Your law.
At midnight I rise to give You thanks
I am a friend to all who fear You,
and to those who keep Your precepts.
The earth is filled with Your loving devotion, O LORD;
